ABOUT US

Zioncom (Hong Kong) Technology Limited is a professional manufacturer for network communication products, including Wireless Router/AP (Indoor & Outdoor), Wireless USB Adapter, Wireless Module, Switch and Wired Router. ZIONCOM (HK) was established on 1999. With more than 21 years of experience, ZIONCOM (HK) has become the trend settlers in the market. We are operating our own production facilities and research and development laboratories at present and offering products and services to customers in over 50 countries and regions. ZIONCOM (HK) has been certified with ISO14001-2004 and ISO9001-2008. ZIONCOM (HK) Products are qualified with CE/FCC certification. With professional mind, we are trying to offer customer the most competitive price, quick lead time for delivery, strict quality inspection and intimate customer service. We have adopted advanced wireless network 802.11ac for Wi-Fi products and combined networking technology with data storage for NAS (Network Attached Storage). To satisfy the customer perfectly, we are managing the safety ability and the design which combines the sensibility and technique, as well as the advanced equipment.

Milestones

2023
         - Passed the IATF16949 quality system certification and entered the Automotive Electronics Processing Industry.

2022
         - Product line extended to Wi-Fi 6 MESH, IoT, NAS and Automotive Electronics.

2020
         - ZIONCOM launched Wi-Fi 6 wireless Router and OLED Display Extender.
         - Construction of our second factory in Vietnam with gross area of approximately 12,000 sq.m.
         - ZIONCOM Vietnam converted to a joint stock company and became ZIONCOM (VIETNAM) JOINT STOCK COMPANY

2019
         - ZIONCOM launched a new product 5G CPE in 2019.


2018
         - ZIONCOM was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(HKEX) in 2018, the stock code is HK.8287.
         - The Vietnam factory has certified by ISO 1400 & 9001.


2017
         - We entered into a Joint Development Agreement with one of our largest customers.
         - Completion of the construction of our factory in Vietnam and commencement of trial production

2016
        - Construction of our factory in Vietnam with gross floor area of approximately 13,000 sq.m.

2015
        - ZIONCOM Shenzhen set up a branch in Xi’an, Shanxi Province, the PRC to continue to expand its software development capacity for software used in our products.
        - ZIONCOM Vietnam was established to enhance our local presence in Vietnam and to enlarge our production capacity.
        - ZIONCOM Taiwan was established for taking up an active role in the sale and distribution of our products under the name TOTOLINK.
 
2014
        - Enter into Taiwan market by engaging an exclusive distributor for selling our products under the brand name TOTOLINK in Taiwan.
        - ZIONCOM Shenzhen set up a branch in Xixiang Sub-district, Shenzhen, the PRC to focus on software development for software used in our products.

2012
        - Registered our trademark TOTOLINK in the PRC.

2011
       - ZIONCOM Shenzhen became a member of Wi-Fi Alliance and was approved as a High and New Technology Enterprise of the PRC and commenced selling our products under our own brand TOTOLINK overseas through distributors.

2009
        - Received ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 certification for our management system for the design and production of our products.

2008
        - Developed our own software to be installed in networking products to be sold to our customers.
        - ZIONCOM Shenzhen was approved as a High and New Technology Enterprise of Shenzhen City.

2007
        - ZIONCOM Shenzhen set up a factory, in Shajing District, Shenzhen, the PRC to increase its production capacity (with four production lines)and a gross floor area of 12,000 sq.m.

2005
        - Launched our first wireless networking product.

2004
        - We commenced cooperation relationship with one of our largest customers.
